featured_reviews.name: Ankit Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is a ONE STOP SOLUTION for any electrical hardware requirements.
In the peak timings, the shop is always crowded (May be a couple of -ve remarks / feedbacks are due to that). The shop is of a medium size & stores almost all electrical accessories / hardware (Wires / converters & many more), its quite understood that in peak timings it may be difficult for the staff to understand your requirements & bring upto to you accordingly. However as of now, my experience has always been a good one. (Tip – Visit the shop in odd hours & you will be able to address your requirements in the best way). The prices are fair enough and reasonable, moreover they also give you options (with respect to pricing / quality both).
In case you are not sure about your requirements & just have the concept, the shop people will guide you on what exactly is to be purchased by you. (It is always advised to do your research & define your requirements & then visit the shop, since there are lot many converters / connectors, the technological advancements may confuse you & the shop attendant both.)
Over a good place for electrical accessories.
